dispute_ticket.description: The driver missed the expressway exit and we drove an extra 3 km. He apologised but I was 9 minutes late for my appointment. I want a full refund of the S$21.00.

chat_logs.content: Sorry, I missed the AYE exit, I'll turn back at the next one.
Please hurry, I have an appointment.

app_events.details: Vehicle passed the planned AYE exit; rerouting. No road closure and no rider request on record.

fare_basis.text: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare that varies with distance and time.

route_deviation_fare_adjustment.text: When the driver leaves the planned route without a verified road closure or an agreed rider request, the rider pays no more than the direct_route_fare in trip_data.fare_breakdown. Lateness or inconvenience is not refunded on top.

detour_for_verified_road_closure_billabl.text: Governs extra distance caused by a road closure. A true value means the rider may be billed for it only when the closure is verified.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The driver passed the planned AYE exit at 14:12:40 (off_route_detected, no closure and no rider request) and his 14:13:10 message admits he missed it, so the route change was his: 13.0 km driven vs 9.8 km planned. This trip's policy limits the rider to the direct_route_fare of S$17.60 in that case. Refund = 21.00 - 17.60 = S$3.40. The 9 minutes of lateness and the appointment are not refunded on top, so the rider's request for the full S$21.00 fails.
